summary: The enterprise AI model API landscape in 2025-2026 is dominated by the three major hyperscalers — AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry (formerly Azure AI Studio/OpenAI Service), and Google Vertex AI Model Garden — which let corporations access foundation models through secure managed APIs without data leaving their cloud boundary. Data-platform-native options like Snowflake Cortex AI and Databricks have surged by bringing governed models (notably Anthropic Claude) directly to enterprise data, while IBM watsonx, Oracle Cloud AI, and Cloudflare Workers AI serve governance-heavy, Oracle-centric, and edge-inference niches respectively. Platform choice is increasingly driven by where an enterprise's existing cloud workload and data already live rather than by raw model availability.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: inference runs inside the enterprise's own cloud/VPC so prompts and proprietary data never leave their governed environment or get used to train vendor models.
Compliance and governance: built-in audit logs, access controls, SOC 2/ISO/HIPAA/FedRAMP certifications, and regional deployment satisfy regulatory and legal requirements out of the box.
Consolidated billing and existing contracts: usage rolls into existing cloud spend commitments (EDPs, MACC, committed-use discounts), avoiding new vendor procurement and finance overhead.

Model flexibility and no lock-in: a single API provides access to multiple model families (GPT, Claude, Llama, Mistral, Gemini, etc.), letting teams switch or multi-source models without rewriting integrations.
Enterprise tooling integration: native connections to identity (IAM/Entra), data warehouses, security tooling, monitoring, and MLOps pipelines that vendor-direct APIs lack.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (input/output per 1M tokens) with on-demand, batch (discounted ~50%), provisioned throughput, and prompt caching; usage billed through existing AWS account.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already standardized on AWS wanting the widest selection of foundation models through one managed API.

platforms.name: Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI Service)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity, batch discounts, and regional deployments; billed via Azure enterprise agreement.
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-centric enterprises wanting first-access OpenAI models with tight M365, Entra, and Copilot integration.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token or per-character/image, with provisioned throughput and committed-use discounts; billed through Google Cloud account.
platforms.best_for: Data- and multimodal-heavy enterprises on Google Cloud needing strong analytics and Gemini-native capabilities.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Snowflake credits tied to token usage; billed within existing Snowflake contract.
key_features: Models run directly on governed data in Snowflake
platforms.best_for: Enterprises with data centralized in Snowflake wanting governed AI applied directly to warehoused data.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based via Databricks Units (DBUs) for model serving and token usage; billed through Databricks/cloud contract.
key_features: Runs on data within the lakehouse
platforms.best_for: Data engineering and ML teams building custom and fine-tuned models on governed lakehouse data.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
available_models: various curated open models from Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Resource-unit / token-based pricing with on-prem, hybrid, and SaaS deployment options; subscription and consumption tiers.
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises and governments needing strong AI governance, indemnification, and on-prem/hybrid control.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token on-demand plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity; billed via OCI/Oracle contract.
key_features: Integration with Oracle Fusion apps and Autonomous DB
platforms.best_for: Oracle database and ERP/Fusion enterprises wanting GenAI integrated with Oracle applications and sovereign regions.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Usage-based (Neurons/tokens) with generous free tier; AI Gateway for caching/rate-limiting across providers.
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency edge inference, open models, and multi-provider gateway control.
